notes.title: Hotfix: v1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixes
Era Points damage bonus now works correctly in all scenarios.

Update the upgrade UI so that it behaves correctly when pressing menu buttons too quickly.



We appreciate all your reports. 





Best regards,

Two Pixels

notes.title: Hotfix: v1.0.2
notes.content:
A small batch of fixes and improvements were released today.


Fixes
Achievements now will unlock correctly. If you've already passed an achievement milestone, the game will run an internal check and unlock everything you should have unlocked.

UI buttons are now rendering correctly, no matter the resolution.


Balancing
Gold to Era Points (prestige) rate decreased.

Era Points (prestige) to DPS (damage) rate decreased.



We appreciate all your reports. 



Best regards,

Two Pixels

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
With the launch fast approaching, we've been playing Timeline Keepers non-stop to find any broken text, bugs, or anything else that might spoil the player's fun.



Tweeks in the balancing, color improvement, optimization even further and much more. We are officially ready. And this time is for REAL!


Timeline Keepers will launch 05/06/2025 in the afternoon - UTC-3.
